data.acceptance:
1. Production rulesets actively protect v2 proposal, writer-registry, inbox, control, canonical, and archive refs with Integration 15368 as the sole bypass actor; the legacy-freeze ruleset exists disabled for knots-d6e4.
2. Ordinary clients may create one immutable proposal ref but cannot update/delete it, and cannot create/update/delete protected writer-registry, inbox, control, canonical, or archive refs.
3. A reachable trusted default-main Action reads a complete signed proposal envelope and exact Git objects as untrusted data, derives repository/current writer authority from protected GitHub state, invokes c472 verification without checkout/execution, and atomically advances the protected writer registry and inbox under exact expected-OID leases.
4. Writer rotation requires a parent key from protected registry state; sequence validation is independent of untrusted proposal-ref aliases; direct inbox writes and caller-selected authority OIDs are rejected.
5. Disposable live canaries prove an authenticated ordinary administrator is denied while Integration 15368 succeeds for protected creation/fast-forward, and prove deletion/non-fast-forward denial before production activation. Provider generation integration and canonical/archive/control publication from protected inboxes are owned by the follow-on provider-integrator Knot.
